entries.template: In how many ways can {objectCount} identical marbles be distributed among {boxCount} labelled boxes when a box may remain empty?
In how many ways can {objectCount} identical sweets be distributed among {boxCount} named children if every child must receive at least one sweet?
In how many ways can {objectCount} identical tokens be placed in {boxCount} numbered boxes if exactly {nonEmptyBoxCount} boxes must be non-empty?
In how many ways can {objectCount} identical balls be distributed among {boxCount} labelled bags so that at least one bag is empty?
In how many ways can {objectCount} identical notebooks be distributed among {boxCount} named students if each student receives at least {minimumPerBox} notebooks?
In how many ways can {objectCount} identical coins be distributed among {boxCount} named persons if one specified person must receive at least {specifiedMinimum} coins? The others may receive none.

In how many ways can {objectCount} identical prizes be distributed among {boxCount} named participants if everyone receives at least one prize and one specified participant receives at least {specifiedMinimum} prizes?
In how many ways can {objectCount} identical files be stored in {boxCount} labelled folders if no folder can contain more than {capacity} files?
In how many ways can {objectCount} identical balls be placed into exactly {nonEmptyBoxCount} identical non-empty boxes?
In how many ways can {objectCount} identical counters be divided among at most {maximumNonEmptyBoxes} identical non-empty boxes?
